text:
Priya Shah: Heads-up — exec briefing runway for SummitCo on Thursday. I pulled the health dashboard; onboarding still stuck at step 3 for parallel imports. Need slide owners and a short remediation ask.

Tom Lin: I can take slide 3 (onboarding status) — will add an embed of the CSV import errors.

Asha Patel: I'll own the renewal risks slide. Quick question: do we have churn signal metrics by cohort?

Luis Gomez: Yes — cohort churn + NPS trend is in `/cs/reports/quarterly/horizon`. I'll paste the key chart before EOD.

Priya Shah: thanks. Two asks: 1) concise remedial steps (2 bullets) per owner, 2) a 1-slide exec-friendly ask (commit + impact). Deadline: tomorrow 5pm PT.

Maya Chen: Can we include an enablement request? SummitCo's AMs need a 20-min playbook on data mapping. I'll draft a runbook.

Tom Lin: putting an `ERROR SNAPSHOT` code block into slide 3 now:
```
Row 42: missing mapping_key -> import failed
Row 43: timestamp format invalid
```

Asha Patel: renewal risk bullets (draft): 
- Integration fragility: 2 failed imports last 30 days -> operational risk
- Feature gap: no private VPC option enabled increases exec concern
Will convert to an ask slide.

Priya Shah: @Luis can you confirm if we can offer a limited free Private trial for 90 days for SummitCo? That would be our primary ask.

Luis Gomez: Checking with product & legal. Quick note: trial requests usually need SOC review; may take ~48-72hrs. Will flag blockers in thread.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy job #4821 completed for `cs-dashboard` (staging) — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

Priya Shah: Thanks. Action check: Tom -> onboarding slide + error screenshot (tomorrow 12pm). Asha -> renewal slide + one-sentence ask (tomorrow 3pm). Maya -> enablement playbook draft (tomorrow 3pm). Luis -> trial feasibility + legal blockers (24-48hrs). I'll compile slides and schedule a 30-min dry run at 10am Wednesday. :calendar: :spiral_calendar:

Tom Lin: ack.

Asha Patel: ack.

Maya Chen: ack.

Luis Gomez: ack, will update thread when I hear back.

Priya Shah: Also please paste any customer quotes or CSAT snippets into the thread — pulling one for the exec slide helps.

Tom Lin: pasting one now: "Support helped us recover imports but we still hit delays" — (SummitCo, AM: Jared)

Priya Shah: Perfect, that's all for now. I'll share the draft deck link when slides are in. Thanks everyone :pray:
